name: panama-payroll
description: Use this skill to run Panama payroll (planilla) in 2026. It covers the employer's income tax withholding on salaries using the art. 700 table (0% to B/.11,000 a year, 15% to B/.50,000, B/.5,850 plus 25% above), the separate table for representation allowances (10% to B/.25,000, then B/.2,500 plus 15%), the monthly DGI Planilla 03 filed within 60 days of the CSS planilla and its fines, and the CSS rates on salaries and on the three 13th-month instalments that live in panama-social-contributions. Trigger phrases include planilla Panama, retencion ISR salarios, gastos de representacion, Planilla 03, decimotercer mes and salario neto Panama.
